description_excerpt: Scope: Fabricated Components Position Summary The Senior Procurement Engineer is responsible for optimizing direct procurement for assigned fabricated components, commodities, and suppliers supporting SE Plant. The role develops and executes sourcing strategies, manages supplier relationships, leads commercial negotiations, drives cost reduction and productivity, and ensures the appropriate balance of cost, quality, delivery, technology, sustainability, and supply continuity. Working closely with Category Management, Engineering/R&D, Quality, Supply Chain, Planning, Manufacturing, Finance,…
